purpose: Replace one Boolean-result classification based on return order with a geometry-semantic predicate.
trigger: Use after a Boolean completed and results are observable but the wrong result member was selected.

inputs.name: result_object_set
inputs.description: Actual Boolean result objects with type/topology/volume/bounds properties.

inputs.name: expected_geometry_relation
inputs.description: One expected result relation and tolerances.

preconditions: Boolean result has completed and result objects are measurable.

outputs.name: measured_predicate
outputs.description: Semantic fields, tolerances, and expected relation.

outputs.name: selected_result
outputs.description: Unique result identity or null when unresolved.

outputs.name: needs_manual_review
outputs.description: True when results cannot distinguish one semantic result.

postconditions: The emitted classifier uses measured semantic predicates and rejects return-order selection; classification execution is not claimed.
No Boolean operation is rerun or changed.

implementation.target_environment: SpaceClaim V21-compatible contract reasoning; no host execution is performed by this operation.
implementation.notes: The reusable artifact is this candidate guidance contract; no executable implementation is claimed. Classification is separate from the Boolean operation and does not assert Boolean success.

ambiguity_checks: Use only the declared identity, state, or geometry predicates; do not substitute recorded FaceN/BodyN aliases or an arbitrary collection member.
If the declared evidence cannot make the target unique, return needs_manual_review and do not continue.
semantic_selection.topology_refresh: After a topology-changing Boolean, enumerate current result objects before classification.

failure_modes.condition: Semantic measurements identify zero or multiple results.
failure_modes.detection: Predicate match count is not one.

recovery.action: Add one justified relation or return needs_manual_review.
Capture missing properties or stop for manual review.

validation.method: Validate this object against operation-template.schema.json and compare operation_id with the EX/ER catalog slug.
validation.expected: The object is schema-valid, remains candidate, and declares exactly one bounded execution_recovery action.

validation.method: Read the linked single-operation guidance and compare its input, result, procedure, and rejection fields with this contract.
validation.expected: The contract exposes every declared input/output and preserves refusal, recovery, and needs_manual_review behavior.

validation.method: Use the operation-specific controller or host-tool adapter only after the required authorization and target-state gates are independently satisfied.
validation.expected: Classification selects one result by measured semantics, not order.

evidence_level.notes: Guidance interface checked on host; synthetic independent application reviewed. No controller event or repaired geometry was observed for this guide.
